cards.name: 短語_一片黃澄澄的稻田
cards.scene: A peaceful old-style painting look: farmers in straw hats working in a wide field of ripe golden rice under the evening sun.

cards.name: 短語_一顆紅通通的蘋果
cards.scene: One shiny bright red apple with a green leaf on a wooden table.

cards.name: 短語_一個圓滾滾的皮球
cards.scene: One round, plump bouncy rubber ball rolling on the grass, a puppy chasing it.

cards.name: 短語_一把綠油油的青菜
cards.scene: A bunch of fresh, shiny bright green leafy vegetables tied together, with water drops on the leaves.

cards.name: 情境_黃澄澄的稻田
cards.scene: Autumn countryside: a big rice field full of ripe golden yellow rice shining in the sunlight, a scarecrow in the middle, a child on the path looking at it.

cards.name: 情境_熱呼呼的牛奶
cards.scene: Winter breakfast table: a mother hands a child a glass cup of hot milk with steam rising from it; the child holds it with both hands.

cards.name: 情境_胖嘟嘟的小豬
cards.scene: On a farm, one very chubby round little pink piglet happily rolling in a mud puddle.

cards.name: 情境_綠油油的草地
cards.scene: A spring park with a big lawn of bright shiny green grass; a family sitting on a picnic blanket on the grass.

cards.name: 短語_一串串飽滿的稻穗
cards.scene: Close-up of many bunches of heavy, plump golden rice ears bending down on their stalks in a field.

cards.name: 短語_一朵朵美麗的鮮花
cards.scene: A garden full of many beautiful fresh flowers of different colors blooming, butterflies around them.

cards.name: 短語_一個個英勇的士兵
cards.scene: A row of brave toy soldiers in bright uniforms standing tall in a line, cartoon style, friendly faces, holding small flags (no weapons).

cards.name: 短語_一隻隻可愛的小狗
cards.scene: A group of many cute fluffy puppies of different colors sitting together in a basket, wagging their tails.

cards.name: 情境_閃亮的星星
cards.scene: Children camping on a mountain at night lying outside their tent, pointing up at a sky full of many bright sparkling stars.

cards.name: 情境_金黃的落葉
cards.scene: An autumn park path covered with many golden yellow fallen leaves; a child walking on them, leaves crunching under the feet.

cards.name: 情境_飽滿的葡萄
cards.scene: A vineyard where many bunches of big, round, juicy purple grapes hang from the vines; a child reaching up to look.

cards.name: 情境_鮮紅的草莓
cards.scene: A strawberry farm with many bright red, big strawberries growing in rows; a child holding a small basket picking them.

cards.name: 短語_刻畫農民樸實的生活
cards.scene: An artist painting at an easel in the countryside; on the canvas a simple painting of farmers in plain clothes bending to work in a field; the real farmers are in the background.

cards.name: 短語_描寫鄉村悠閒的生活
cards.scene: A writer sitting under a tree in a quiet village writing in a notebook, watching an old man slowly fishing and a cat napping; relaxed slow feeling.

cards.name: 短語_採摘菜園新鮮的蔬菜
cards.scene: A child and grandma picking fresh tomatoes, cucumbers and lettuce from a vegetable garden into a basket.

cards.name: 短語_展現舞者優雅的舞步
cards.scene: A ballet dancer on a stage doing a graceful turn on her toes, arms gently raised, flowing skirt.

cards.name: 情境_媽媽拿手的好菜
cards.scene: Dinner time: a table full of home-cooked dishes; a mother in an apron proudly serving; a child tasting a bite slowly with a delighted face.

cards.name: 情境_小鳥好聽的歌聲
cards.scene: Morning in a park: several small birds singing on a tree branch with music notes floating; a child stopped on the path, hand behind ear, listening carefully.

cards.name: 情境_山上美麗的風景
cards.scene: On a school field trip, a class of children standing on a mountain viewing platform with a railing, looking at beautiful far mountains and a sea of clouds, amazed.

cards.name: 情境_弟弟可愛的笑容
cards.scene: A little brother blowing out candles on a birthday cake, laughing happily; an older sister holding up a smartphone taking a photo of him.
